note: THE register of deferred work. Machine-checked on every certify run by scripts/deferred-register.mjs, which re-derives each item's state from live production and from the repo on disk. An item being OPEN is data, not a failure; the register being WRONG ABOUT ITSELF is the failure. Add items with `npm run defer` — it validates the entry and DRY-RUNS the verification before writing, so a stale entry cannot be seeded. Read the header of scripts/deferred-register.mjs for the seven failure conditions and why none of them can erode into permanent red. docs/45, docs/50, docs/51 and docs/53 are HISTORY: they record how each finding was measured. This file is the live state.
seeded_from: docs/53-deferred-work-census.md (commit 054bd520, 2026-08-12) — all 47 still-open items, each re-verified against live code/DB before being recorded here.

items.what: The `storage` schema default ACL grants anon and authenticated arwdDxtm on every new table; both roles hold TRUNCATE on storage.objects right now. Same shape docs/52 spent six migrations closing in `public`, one schema over, with a worse grantee.

verification.sql: select (has_table_privilege('anon','storage.objects','TRUNCATE')::int + has_table_privilege('authenticated','storage.objects','TRUNCATE')::int) as n
verification.note: Asks the catalogue the sharpest single question the finding contains. RLS does not apply to TRUNCATE, so either grant is one statement away from destroying every tenant's stored objects.

items.what: The `public` default-ACL row whose grantor is supabase_admin still reads anon=arwdDxtm | authenticated=arwdDxtm — the half of mig 715 that returned 42501.

items.what: No per-data-subject erasure exists. Whole-tenant deletion is solid (delete_tenant: platform-capability gated, must be suspended first, exact-slug confirm, pre-counted receipt) and telemetry retention IS automated (otel-spans-prune, adjudication-retention, dispatch-log-prune run daily). But if one END USER asks to be forgotten there is no function for it — only forget_de_memory and redact_old_adjudications exist — and customer content (conversations, messages, knowledge) has no retention policy at all.
